experiment: From-scratch online learning on the looped sample clip (FFSb - Corona LSFB, 22.5 s at 23.976 fps, looped to 1800 frames)

config.network: CorticalFlowNet defaults (channels 16,32,64; strides 1,4,8), random init, seed 0
config.learner: OnlineLearner(learning_rate=1e-3, anchor_weight=0, batch_size=2, burn_in=8, window=6), stepped synchronously

note: The clip repeats every 540 frames, so windows after the first two include footage the learner has already seen. The second window (frames 300-600) is mostly first-pass footage.
